description: Signaleringskaart buisleidingen - Aardgas- en overige leidingen is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by NationaalGeoregister.nl. De buisleidingenkaart laat alle buisleidingen zien die in de Risicokaart zijn opgenomen ( inclusief buisleidingstroken en -straten. Buisleidingen transporteren stoffen ten behoeve van regionale en nationale distributie en industrie. Buisleidingen hebben vaak een grote diameter, zijn duur in aanleg en een belangrijke beperkende factor in ruimtelijke ontwikkeling. Coverage: the Netherlands. The portal files it under the publisher NationaalGeoregister.nl. Its tags are infrastructuur, leidingen. It offers 5 resource(s) in HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/HTML, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/JSON, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/PNG, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WFS_SRVC, HTTP://PUBLICATIONS.EUROPA.EU/RESOURCE/AUTHORITY/FILE-TYPE/WMS_SRVC. The portal shows 2026-08-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support pipeline routing and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
